thread:
maria: Hey infra — need to onboard new project `redwood-eval-eu`. Request: 8x H100 in europe-west1 (dedicated), plus 16x L4 in us-central1 for mixed workloads. Also need 4 external NAT IPs and increase for forwarding rules (>25). Target deploy window next week.

lee: cc @jack for billing approval. timeline tight — what's the cost hit?

maria: Quick estimate: 8 H100 dedicated ~ $2.5k/day on-demand. L4 fleet cheaper ~ $400/day for 16. If we go reserved/dedicated commit can drop ~20-30%. Will produce a detailed cost sheet.

sasha: infra-approvals-bot: before we escalate, confirm billing account linked and IAM: service account `infra-service@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` needs Compute Admin on project. Also we need org policy OK for external IPs.

rohit: Note: europe-west1 has limited H100 capacity right now — might be quota-able but not physically available. Recommend fallback region europe-west4 or take partial quota + smart routing. Also GCP treats GPU quota and EIP/NAT as separate support categories.

jack: Billing: we can approve up to $200k/month for this pilot provided SRE signs off autoscaling and budget alerts. Need expected sustained hours to finalize. :money_with_wings:

maria: Pilot plan: 72h steady load, then scale down. Attaching runbook (will post link in ticket). Need VPC-NAT quota increase (default 5) to 9.

deploy-bot: AUTO: Quota request submitted to GCP at 2026-03-15T09:18:23Z. Request ID: GCP-REQ-20260315-3891.

lee: Can you paste the exact gcloud command you ran for the accel quota?

maria: ```
# example command used (alpha API for region-level accel quotas)
gcloud alpha compute regions update europe-west1 \
  --project=redwood-eval-eu \
  --add-accelerator-quota=accelerator_type=h100,count=8
```

rohit: FYI: internal process prefers opening a Support Case via console with workload justification + expected core-hours. Category: "Compute Engine > GPU quota". Include model/driver requirements and HA plan. GCP support asks for fallback plan if region capacity is constrained.

sasha: Security check: public IPs need approval. @security please confirm NAT policy and whether we can use Cloud NAT with private egress for the pilot.

security: security: Need to ensure no plaintext keys leave the VPC and that audit logging is enabled. We also prefer private Google access for meter upload. Approve conditional on runbook updates.

jack: Approve project creation and billing link. Pending SRE + security sign-off. @sre please ACK before EOD so we can mark the request high priority.

sre: Acked. We'll add autoscaler guardrails, reclaim policies and preemptible fallback. Recommend canary deploy to europe-west4 if west1 returns capacity issues.

maria: Thanks — I'll update the support case with cost breakdown, runbook, and fallback regions. Moving status to "waiting on GCP response".

infra-approvals-bot: STATUS UPDATE: Support case GCP-REQ-20260315-3891 created. Estimated response 24-48 hours. Labels: [gpu-onboard, high-priority].

maria: Tagging @lee and @jack — will follow up once GCP confirms region capacity. :white_check_mark:
